title: Capability Binding
description: Implementation binding for a CDL capability. Separate from CDL — describes how, not what.

origins.description: Where values of an origin-bound semantic type in this capability's output may point. Implementation, not CDL: a statement about the provider's response data, checked by the response mapper. Each entry is a bare https origin (scheme, host, optional port) — the semantic pass checks the entry syntax.

pages.description: Origins a `web-page` output value may live on, e.g. https://www.example.com. A value on any other origin is withheld.
